article.title: Dandiya Invitation in Marathi: Society, Bhondla and Puja Wordings
article.excerpt: Seven original Marathi dandiya and Navratri invitation wordings for housing societies, Bhondla, ghatasthapana and one special person, each in Devanagari, romanised Marathi and English, with register checked against Molesworth's 1857 dictionary and send-by dates.

keyTakeaways: आग्रहाचे निमंत्रण is the strong form: Molesworth's 1857 dictionary (p. 63) glosses आग्रह as 'urgent invitation or earnest pressing'.
स्नेहांकित before your name is the Marathi 'yours affectionately' (Molesworth p. 876); a society committee signs आपले नम्र instead.
A society card should go out by 9 October 2026 (28 September 2027) so passes can be collected before night one.
48.3% of SubhSandesh page views are on a phone, so keep the date, time and venue in the top half of the card.
Be My Dandiya Partner is one-to-one with an English interface: the wrong tool for a society, Bhondla or puja invitation.

faqs.question: How do you say dandiya invitation in Marathi?
faqs.answer: दांडिया निमंत्रण (dāṇḍiyā nimantraṇ), or दांडियाचे निमंत्रण inside a sentence. आमंत्रण is also correct: Molesworth's 1857 Marathi dictionary glosses both निमंत्रण (p. 467) and आमंत्रण (p. 72) as an invitation.

faqs.question: What is the difference between सस्नेह निमंत्रण and आग्रहाचे निमंत्रण?
faqs.answer: सस्नेह निमंत्रण is an invitation 'with affection', warm and safe for any card. आग्रहाचे निमंत्रण is stronger: Molesworth glosses आग्रह as 'urgent invitation or earnest pressing', so use it when you really want people to come, such as the society's opening night.

faqs.question: How do I write a housing society dandiya invitation in Marathi?
faqs.answer: Start with ॥ नवरात्रोत्सव ॥, then the society name with सर्व सभासदांना आग्रहाचे निमंत्रण, then dates, start time and venue, the pass collection line, a smaller सौजन्य sponsor line, and sign off आपले नम्र, व्यवस्थापन समिती. Add one English line if the building is mixed-language.

faqs.question: What should a Navratri invitation card in Marathi say for ghatasthapana?
faqs.answer: Name the day (आश्विन शुद्ध प्रतिपदा), the date and the puja time, and ask guests to come सहकुटुंब, with your family. Ghatasthapana falls on Sunday 11 October 2026 and Thursday 30 September 2027; send the card two days before.

faqs.question: Is a garba invitation in Marathi worded differently from a dandiya one?
faqs.answer: The structure is the same; swap दांडिया for गरबा in the event line. For a women's and girls' ring dance in a Maharashtrian home or society, the event you are probably inviting people to is भोंडला, and the card should say so.

faqs.question: What is Bhondla, and who gets invited?
faqs.answer: Bhondla is a Navratri gathering of women and girls who sing and dance in a ring. Molesworth's 1857 dictionary records it as figures drawn on walls by little girls in Ashwin and the singing before them, so invitations go to girls, their mothers and the society's women.

faqs.question: Should a Marathi invitation be in Devanagari or English letters?
faqs.answer: Devanagari for Marathi readers, with one English line underneath for neighbours who do not read it. Romanised Marathi helps people who speak Marathi but do not read Devanagari. Use one numeral system per card so times are not misread.

faqs.question: When should a society send its dandiya invitation?
faqs.answer: Two days before night one, so passes can be collected: 9 October 2026 for a Navratri that starts on 11 October, or 28 September 2027. Send a short WhatsApp reminder the evening before night one.

faqs.question: Can I use Be My Dandiya Partner for a society or Bhondla invitation?
faqs.answer: No. Be My Dandiya Partner is a one-to-one invitation for your love, your crush or a best friend as a garba buddy. For a society, a Bhondla or a puja, send a card image or a WhatsApp text to the group instead.

faqs.question: Is the Be My Dandiya Partner page available in Marathi?
faqs.answer: Its interface is in English. You can type your own lines, including in Marathi, but check how Devanagari looks in the preview before you publish and send the link.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Dandiya Invitation in Marathi: Society, Bhondla and Puja Wordings

A dandiya invitation in Marathi (दांडिया निमंत्रण) opens with a register phrase such as **आग्रहाचे निमंत्रण** or **सस्नेह निमंत्रण**, names who is inviting (society committee, mandal or family), gives the night, वेळ (time) and स्थळ (venue), adds dress code and pass collection, and closes with the inviter's name. Two of our own numbers shape it. 48.3% of SubhSandesh pages are opened on a phone, so the card must read on one WhatsApp screen. And in our Raksha Bandhan data, the nearest festival measurement we have and not a Navratri figure, 49.4% of pages were built on the festival day itself, which is too late for a society that needs passes collected. Below: 7 original wordings in Devanagari, romanised Marathi and English, register choices checked against Molesworth's Marathi dictionary, and a card layout.

## What goes into a Marathi dandiya invitation?

A Marathi dandiya invitation is a short card or message asking people to a dandiya or garba night during नवरात्र (Navratri). It has six parts: occasion line, opening phrase, inviter, date-time-venue block, practical lines, and sign-off.

Both Marathi words for it are old and correct. Molesworth's 1857 *A Dictionary, Marathi and English* glosses [निमंत्रण (nimantraṇa) as "inviting; an invitation"](https://dsal.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/app/molesworth_query.py?qs=%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%A3&searchhws=yes) on page 467, and आमंत्रण on page 72 as "a call or summons" and "an invitation". This page uses निमंत्रण so the cards match.

Sharad Navratri 2026 runs from Sunday 11 October to Monday 19 October, with Dussehra on Tuesday 20 October. In 2027 it runs from 30 September to 8 October, with Dussehra on 9 October (Drik Panchang, New Delhi).

## Which register: आग्रहाचे, सस्नेह or स्नेहांकित?

Register sits in three places: opening phrase, verb and sign-off.

- **आग्रहाचे निमंत्रण** (āgrahāche nimantraṇ, "a pressing invitation"). Molesworth's second sense of [आग्रह is "earnest solicitation: also urgent invitation or earnest pressing"](https://dsal.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/app/molesworth_query.py?qs=%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%B9&searchhws=yes), page 63. Use it when you genuinely want people there.
- **सस्नेह निमंत्रण** (sasneh nimantraṇ, "an invitation with affection"). सस्नेह has no headword in the 1857 dictionary, so we cannot date it from there. Its root [स्नेह is glossed "affection, attachment, fondness, friendship, love"](https://dsal.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/app/molesworth_query.py?qs=%E0%A4%B8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%87%E0%A4%B9&searchhws=yes) on page 876. Treat it as later card register, warm and safe.
- **स्नेहांकित** (snehāṅkit) before your name. The same page calls it "a term used in epistles before the writer's own name", the Marathi "yours affectionately". It suits family cards; a committee signs आपले नम्र ("yours humbly").

The verb carries the rest. आपण अवश्य यावे (āpaṇ avashya yāve) is the formal "please do come"; नक्की या is polite and warm; नक्की ये is intimate, for one friend or partner. A 2024 *Rupkatha Journal* study of the Marathi address term माउली found its [honorific level depends on the accompanying verb, much like a T/V distinction](https://rupkatha.com/V16/n2/v16n218g.pdf); 72 of its 83 Pandharpur Wari pilgrims (86.74%) used the term in both directions, and 46.94% of responses tied it to politeness and respect. On a card, one wrong verb ending undoes a polite opening.

## 7 Marathi dandiya and Navratri invitation wordings

Each gives Devanagari, romanised Marathi, an English gloss and a send-by date. Brackets and times are placeholders.

### 1. Housing society dandiya: the committee card

**Use when:** the housing society committee invites every flat. **Send by:** 9 October 2026 (28 September 2027), so passes can be collected.

> ॥ नवरात्रोत्सव [वर्ष] ॥  
> [सोसायटीचे नाव] सहकारी गृहनिर्माण संस्थेतर्फे सर्व सभासदांना दांडिया रासचे आग्रहाचे निमंत्रण.  
> दिनांक: [ ] ते [ ] · वेळ: सायं. [७.३०] पासून · स्थळ: सोसायटी आवार  
> पास वितरण: क्लब हाऊस, [दिनांक], प्रति सदनिका [ ] पास  
> सौजन्य: [प्रायोजक]  
> आपले नम्र, व्यवस्थापन समिती

**Romanised:** [Society] sahakārī gṛhanirmāṇ sansthetarphe sarva sabhāsadānnā dāṇḍiyā rāsache āgrahāche nimantraṇ. Pās vitaraṇ: klab hāus.

**Gloss:** "[Society] Co-operative Housing Society warmly urges all members to dandiya raas. Passes at the clubhouse, [n] per flat. Courtesy: [sponsor]. Yours humbly, the managing committee."

### 2. Mandal or ticketed dandiya night

**Use when:** a mandal or club issues passes to outsiders. **Send by:** a week before night one.

> [मंडळाचे नाव] आयोजित 'रास दांडिया [वर्ष]': नवरात्राच्या नऊ रात्री, [स्थळ]. प्रवेश फक्त पासद्वारे. पारंपरिक पोशाखात यावे.

**Romanised:** [Mandal] āyojit 'Rās Dāṇḍiyā': navarātrāchyā naū rātrī. Pravesh phakta pāsdvāre. Pāramparik poshākhāt yāve.

**Gloss:** "[Mandal] presents Raas Dandiya, all nine nights of Navratri at [venue]. Entry by pass only. Please come in traditional dress."

### 3. Bhondla for girls, at home

**Use when:** a mother invites her daughter's friends. Molesworth defines [भोंडला as figures "drawn on the walls by little girls in the month आश्विन: also the singing performed before these figures"](https://dsal.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/app/molesworth_query.py?qs=%E0%A4%AD%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A1%E0%A4%B2%E0%A4%BE&searchhws=yes) (page 622). **Send by:** two days ahead.

> भोंडल्याचे निमंत्रण! [दिनांक] रोजी सायं. [५] वाजता आमच्या घरी भोंडला आहे. फेर धरू, गाणी म्हणू आणि खिरापत ओळखू. [मुलीचे नाव]ला नक्की पाठवा.

**Romanised:** Bhoṇḍalyāche nimantraṇ! [Date] rojī āmchyā gharī bhoṇḍalā āhe. Pher dharū, gāṇī mhaṇū āṇi khirāpat oḷkhū.

**Gloss:** "A Bhondla invitation! Bhondla at our home on [date] at [5] pm. We'll dance in a ring, sing and guess the khirapat. Do send [name]."

### 4. Society Bhondla for women and girls

**Use when:** the society's women host. [Maharashtra Tourism](https://maharashtratourism.gov.in/culture/bhondla/) describes Bhondla as an evening gathering where women and girls sing and dance in a circle, holding hands. **Send by:** three days ahead.

> सोसायटीतील सर्व महिला व मुलींना सस्नेह निमंत्रण: [दिनांक], सायं. [६] वाजता, [स्थळ] येथे भोंडला. येताना आपली खिरापत घेऊन या.

**Romanised:** Sosāyaṭītīl sarva mahilā va mulīnnā sasneh nimantraṇ: [date], [venue] ethe bhoṇḍalā. Yetānā āpalī khirāpat gheūn yā.

**Gloss:** "A warm invitation to all women and girls of the society: Bhondla on [date] at [6] pm, at [venue]. Please bring your khirapat."

### 5. Ghatasthapana at home

**Use when:** family and neighbours come for the first-day puja, on आश्विन शुद्ध प्रतिपदा: Sunday 11 October 2026, Thursday 30 September 2027. **Send by:** two days ahead.

> आश्विन शुद्ध प्रतिपदेला, [दिनांक] रोजी, आमच्या घरी घटस्थापना आहे. सकाळी [वेळ] पूजा व आरती. आपण सहकुटुंब अवश्य यावे.  
> स्नेहांकित, [कुटुंबाचे नाव]

**Romanised:** Āshvin shuddha pratipadelā āmchyā gharī ghaṭasthāpanā āhe. Āpaṇ sahakuṭumb avashya yāve. Snehāṅkit, [family].

**Gloss:** "On the first day of Ashwin's bright fortnight, [date], we install the ghat at home. Puja and aarti at [time]. Please come with your family. Affectionately, [family]."

### 6. Ashtami and Navami at home

**Use when:** the family hosts the Ashtami or Navami puja. In 2026 both fall on Monday 19 October (IST), so one card covers them. **Send by:** 16 October 2026.

> [दिनांक] रोजी अष्टमी व नवमीनिमित्त देवीची पूजा, त्यानंतर महाप्रसाद. आपल्या उपस्थितीने आनंद द्विगुणित होईल.

**Romanised:** Aṣṭamī va navamīnimitta devīchī pūjā, tyānantar mahāprasād. Āpalyā upasthitīne ānand dviguṇit hoīl.

**Gloss:** "Devi puja for Ashtami and Navami on [date], then mahaprasad. Your presence will double our joy."

### 7. One person: be my dandiya partner

**Use when:** you are asking one person. **Send by:** before the night you want.

> [नाव], या नवरात्रात माझा दांडिया पार्टनर होशील का? [दिनांक], [स्थळ]. फक्त हो म्हण, पास मी आणतो/आणते.

**Romanised:** [Name], yā navarātrāt mājhā dāṇḍiyā pārṭanar hoshīl kā? Phakta ho mhaṇ, pās mī āṇto/āṇte.

**Gloss:** "[Name], will you be my dandiya partner this Navratri? Just say yes; I'll bring the passes." होशील and म्हण are intimate forms, for someone you already call तू.

## How should a Marathi dandiya card be laid out?

A committee card runs top to bottom in six blocks: occasion line (॥ नवरात्रोत्सव ॥), opening phrase, inviter, date-time-venue, practical lines, then sign-off with a smaller सौजन्य sponsor line. Keep date-time-venue in the top half: 48.3% of our page views happen on a phone, and that half is what shows without scrolling.

Mumbai and Pune societies are often mixed-language, so add one English line for neighbours who do not read Devanagari. Use one numeral system per card; ७.३० and 7.30 on the same card invite mistakes.

Print only an end time your society's permission confirms; we found no verifiable Maharashtra-specific source on loudspeaker hours, so this page gives none.

## Committee card, WhatsApp reminder, printed card or page: lead times compared

The four formats differ in reach and lead time.

| Format | Reaches | Send by (2026) | What our data says |
|---|---|---|---|
| Committee card as a WhatsApp image | Every flat, one post | 9 Oct | 48.3% of SubhSandesh views are on a phone: design portrait |
| Two-line WhatsApp reminder | People already in the group | 10 Oct | 49.4% of Raksha Bandhan pages were built on the day (analogue) |
| Printed card on the notice board | Elders without smartphones | Before 11 Oct | None measured |
| Be My Dandiya Partner page | One person | Any night up to 19 Oct | 38.5% of creators password-protect their page |

Group invitations need lead time because passes and food are counted; a one-person invite can go out on the night.

## Asking one person: what the Be My Dandiya Partner page does

For wording 7 there is a page version. [Be My Dandiya Partner](https://subhsandesh.in/dandiya-partner) takes nine short lines, one per night, up to six photos, and the date, time, venue and dress code. The recipient clashes dandiya sticks to open an envelope, lights nine diyas, picks the colour they will twirl in, and gets a 1080×1920 Dandiya Pass sized for an Instagram Story. Its No button gives up after five tries and becomes a second Yes.

Two plain limits. The interface is in English; you can type your own lines, but check how Devanagari looks in the preview before publishing. And it is one-to-one: the wrong tool for a society card, a Bhondla or a ghatasthapana invite. It does not sell garba passes or find anyone a partner.

If the plan is dinner after the dance, a [date invitation page](https://subhsandesh.in/date-invitation) fits better, because it asks about the evening rather than the garba circle.

## Where a Marathi card falls short

- **Elders without smartphones.** A phone call or printed card beats any image;
- **A Marathi-only card in a mixed society.** Neighbours will miss the pass dates.
- **Last-minute group invites.** Building on the day, as 49.4% of our Raksha Bandhan pages were, works for one person, not a building collecting passes.
- **Our own data.** Be My Dandiya Partner is new; we have no Navratri usage numbers for it.

## Sources

- Molesworth, J. T., *A Dictionary, Marathi and English*, 2nd ed., 1857 (Digital Dictionaries of South Asia, University of Chicago): निमंत्रण p. 467, आमंत्रण p. 72, आग्रह p. 63, स्नेह and स्नेहांकित p. 876, भोंडला p. 622.
- Metkari, H., Kudale, K. M. and Vishwanathan, M. R. (18 June 2024). "Exploring the Complexity of Mauli". *Rupkatha Journal* 16(2). Open access.
- Maharashtra Department of Tourism, "Bhondla" (no publication date).
- Drik Panchang, Shardiya Navratri 2026 calendar, New Delhi (date check only).
